The '''''New Crucible''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that served the [[Arkadianate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that operated in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the ''New Crucible'' served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of an Arkadianate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that [[Battle of Byllura|attacked]] forces of the [[Dyarchy]] Sith state over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byllura]].
